correctness.rationale: The exact GF(8) arithmetic and generator matrix were independently reconstructed using the polynomial relation defining the field. The baseline code has rank 3 and hull dimension 1. For a monomial transform, the Gram rank depends only on diagonal coordinate squares, and a common nonzero scalar can be normalized away, leaving exactly \(7^5=16807\) scalings. Independent exhaustive Gram-rank enumeration reproduced hull counts 14685, 2091, 31, 0 in dimensions 0,1,2,3 respectively, so the attainable spectrum is exactly {0,1,2}, the maximum is 2, and no monomially equivalent code is self-dual.
